summary: The user selected one unified board/process outcome (#4701), including comprehensive design, meaningful shaping of all15current broad Outcomes, intake/p-add, useful parallelism, same-owner execution, stop/resume/handoff and retirement. Both runtime roots, Claude bindings, metadata, actual package/receiver references and guards require coherent delivery. This is source/fixture evidence, not live installed efficiency or economic benefit. Actual publication, selected installed caller/receiver qualification, expanded protected enrollment, native decomposition and continuous-use acceptance remain separate open gates under4701. Original439inherited and46later Unknown holds remain distinct/unreleased; no original-effect replay or fleet-retirement claim follows. Native issue/PR and stableAtlaspointers carry recovery; reports save only missing information. Two new regressions failed the original source; fixed acquisition globally refuses missing/malformed/unattributable error paths while scoping only valid known aliases, and preserves single-character names/quoted literals.
